facts.fact: TechnoMag reports Zimbabwe has officially launched its National AI Strategy (2026-2030); the article gives no event date, so its published date of 2026-03-16 is used.

TechnoMag says implementation will be overseen by the AI Strategy Implementation Office (AISIO), supported by funding from the Treasury and the Universal Service Fund managed by POTRAZ; no amount is given and the published date of 2026-03-16 is used.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT, Postal and Courier Services
